観.name: View
観.reading: It's next to a kangaroo, かん, who's also admiring it. 観光 is sightseeing; 観客 an audience.

察.name: Guess
察.meaning: A <radical>festival</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. It's indoors this year, so you have to <kanji>guess</kanji> what's going on in there.
察.reading: The police send a satellite, さつ, to inspect. 警察 is police; 観察 observation.

達.name: Reach
達.meaning: A <radical>sheep</radical> on <radical>dirt</radical> riding a <radical>scooter</radical>. It rides until it <kanji>reach</kanji>es its goal.
達.reading: It gets a tattoo, たつ, to celebrate. 友達 is friends (だち); 達成 achievement.

良.name: Good
良.meaning: A dot on top of a stubborn root. A healthy root means a <kanji>good</kanji> plant.
良.reading: It wins the rodeo, りょう. 良い is good (よい); 不良 a delinquent.

候.name: Weather
候.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a <radical>stick</radical> and an <radical>arrow</radical>. They stick the arrow in the ground to check the wind: <kanji>weather</kanji>.
候.reading: A koala, こう, reads the forecast. 天候 is weather; 気候 climate.

満.name: Full
満.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>grass</radical> and <radical>both</radical>. Both sides of the pond are <kanji>full</kanji> to the brim.
満.reading: A man in a suit, まん, falls in. 満足 is satisfaction; 満員 full of people.

敗.name: Defeat
敗.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Whip the money out of their hands: <kanji>defeat</kanji>.
敗.reading: Loser gets a sad high five, はい. 失敗 is failure.

責.name: Blame
責.meaning: <radical>Life</radical> over a <radical>shell</radical>. You spent your life's money, and you're to <kanji>blame</kanji>.
責.reading: You hid it in a sack of rice, せき. 責任 is responsibility; 責める to blame.

積.name: Pile Up
積.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> and <radical>blame</radical>. You're blamed for letting the grain <kanji>pile up</kanji>.
積.reading: Every sack of rice, せき, adds to the heap. 積む is to pile up; 面積 area.

飛.name: Fly
飛.meaning: The <radical>fly</radical> radical: wings on both sides. <kanji>Fly</kanji>.
飛.reading: Fly high on your heels, ひ. 飛行機 is an aeroplane; 飛ぶ to fly.

殺.name: Kill
殺.meaning: Something <radical>slide</radical>s off a <radical>tree</radical> next to a <radical>weapon</radical>. That's how you <kanji>kill</kanji> it.
殺.reading: It was spotted by satellite, さつ. 殺す is to kill; 自殺 suicide.

完.name: Perfect
完.meaning: The <radical>origin</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. Back home where you started, everything is <kanji>perfect</kanji>.
完.reading: A kangaroo, かん, hops in to finish it. 完全 is complete; 完成 completion.

給.name: Salary
給.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> that <radical>fit</radical>s. The tailor gets a <kanji>salary</kanji> for every seam that fits.
給.reading: Paid by cue stick, きゅう, for some reason. 給料 is salary.

辞.name: Resign
辞.meaning: A <radical>tongue</radical> that tastes something <radical>spicy</radical>. Too spicy! You <kanji>resign</kanji> from the chili contest. Also, words you say when you quit.
辞.reading: You storm out in a jeep, じ. 辞書 is a dictionary; 辞める to quit.

愛.name: Love
愛.meaning: A <radical>claw</radical> reaching down past a <radical>lid</radical> for your <radical>heart</radical>, while <radical>winter</radical> legs drag it away. That's <kanji>love</kanji>.
愛.reading: It's all for your eyes, あい. 愛 is love; 恋愛 romance.

未.name: Not Yet
未.meaning: A tree with a short branch on top. It has <kanji>not yet</kanji> grown up.
未.reading: Show Mii the mouse, み. 未来 is the future.

冷.name: Cold
冷.meaning: <radical>Ice</radical> by <radical>order</radical>. The boss orders the drinks served <kanji>cold</kanji>.
冷.reading: Chill them with a ray gun, れい. 冷たい is cold (to touch); 冷蔵庫 a fridge.

類.name: Kind
類.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical>, something <radical>big</radical> and a <radical>head</radical>. Sort everything by <kanji>kind</kanji>: rice here, big heads there.
類.reading: Louie the lumberjack, るい, sorts the logs. 種類 is kind, type.

熱.name: Heat
熱.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, <radical>legs</radical>, something <radical>round</radical> and <radical>fire</radical> underneath. The ground's so hot you run around in circles. <kanji>Heat</kanji>!
熱.reading: Catch the heat in a net, ねつ. 熱 is fever; 熱い hot.

覚.name: Remember
覚.meaning: <radical>Sparkle</radical> over a <radical>lid</radical> over <radical>see</radical>. What you see shines in your head so you'll <kanji>remember</kanji> it.
覚.reading: A cackling witch, かく, makes sure of it. 覚える is to remember; 目覚まし an alarm.

更.name: Again
更.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over the <radical>ground</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> through it. The sun rises <kanji>again</kanji>, a fresh start.
更.reading: A koala, こう, watches it rise. 変更 is a change; 更に furthermore (さら).

便.name: Convenient
便.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> who does it <radical>again</radical> and again for you. How <kanji>convenient</kanji>.
便.reading: They leave it on your bench, べん. 便利 is convenient; 郵便 mail (びん).

努.name: Effort
努.meaning: A <radical>guy</radical> with <radical>power</radical>. He puts in the <kanji>effort</kanji>.
努.reading: He lifts a door, ど, over his head. 努力 is effort.

散.name: Scatter
散.meaning: The <radical>moon</radical> and a <radical>whip</radical>. Crack the whip at night and everyone <kanji>scatter</kanji>s.
散.reading: They scatter into the sun, さん. 散歩 is a walk; 散る to scatter.

静.name: Quiet
静.reading: You sail, せい, on a calm sea. 静か is quiet.

喜.name: Rejoice
喜.meaning: <radical>Good luck</radical> over an open <radical>mouth</radical>. You get lucky and shout: <kanji>rejoice</kanji>!
喜.reading: You found a key, き. 喜ぶ is to be happy.

老.name: Old
老.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical> with a <radical>spoon</radical> beside it. A spoon buried so long it's <kanji>old</kanji>.
老.reading: It's tied with a rope, ろう. 老人 is an old person.

徒.name: Pupil
徒.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> and <radical>run</radical>ning. <kanji>Pupil</kanji>s run to school on foot.
徒.reading: They run on their toes, と. 生徒 is a student.

願.name: Request
願.meaning: The <radical>original</radical> <radical>head</radical>. You bow your head to the source and make a <kanji>request</kanji>.
願.reading: Fire a gun, がん, to get attention. お願い is please.

笑.name: Laugh
笑.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> over something <radical>big</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical>. The big panda slides off the bamboo and everyone <kanji>laugh</kanji>s.
笑.reading: It's the best show, しょう. 笑う is to laugh; 笑顔 a smile (えがお).

折.name: Fold
折.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> and an <radical>axe</radical>. Your fingers <kanji>fold</kanji> the paper; the axe breaks the stick.
折.reading: おる: fold it into an oar. 折る is to fold; 折り紙 origami. In compounds, せつ.

政.name: Politics
政.reading: They sail, せい, to the capital. 政治 is politics; 政府 government.

経.name: Pass Through
経.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> on a <radical>stool</radical> over <radical>dirt</radical>. You <kanji>pass</kanji> the thread <kanji>through</kanji> the loom, one pass at a time.
経.reading: You weave a cake, けい. 経験 is experience; 経済 economy.

現.name: Present
現.meaning: A <radical>king</radical> you can <radical>see</radical>. He's <kanji>present</kanji>, right there.
現.reading: He appears out of a lamp: he's a genie, げん. 現在 is now; 現れる to appear.

性.name: Nature
性.reading: Your nature is to sail, せい. 女性 is a woman; 性格 personality.

制.name: System
制.meaning: A <radical>cow</radical>, a <radical>towel</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. The butcher has a <kanji>system</kanji> for everything.
制.reading: He's building a sail, せい. 制度 is a system; 制服 a uniform.

務.name: Duty
務.reading: A mooing cow, む, stands guard too. 事務所 is an office; 義務 duty.

支.name: Support
支.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> on a <radical>stool</radical>. The cross-brace is there to <kanji>support</kanji> it.
支.reading: A sheep, し, leans on it. 支える is to support; 支店 a branch office.

報.name: Report
報.meaning: <radical>Happiness</radical>, a <radical>stamp</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>. Stamp the good news and stand on a stool to <kanji>report</kanji> it.
報.reading: Spray it with a hose, ほう. 報告 is a report; 情報 information.

解.name: Solve
解.meaning: A <radical>horn</radical>, a <radical>sword</radical> and a <radical>cow</radical>. Take the sword to the cow's horns and <kanji>solve</kanji> the problem.
解.reading: Fly a kite, かい, to celebrate. 理解 is understanding; 解決 solution.

資.name: Resources
資.reading: Spend it on a sheep, し. 資料 is materials; 資格 qualification.

際.name: Occasion
際.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> next to a <radical>festival</radical>. It's a special <kanji>occasion</kanji>.
際.reading: Swing a scythe, さい, to cut the ribbon. 国際 is international; 実際 actually.

判.name: Judgement
判.meaning: <radical>Half</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut it in half: that's the <kanji>judgement</kanji>.
判.reading: The judge raises a hand, はん. 判断 is judgement; 評判 reputation (ばん).

在.name: Exist
在.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> on the <radical>dirt</radical> under a roof. They <kanji>exist</kanji>, right here.
在.reading: Playing a xylophone, ざい. 現在 is now; 存在 existence.

件.name: Matter
件.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and a <radical>cow</radical>. Whose cow is it? That's the <kanji>matter</kanji> in question.
件.reading: Ken, けん, says it's his. 事件 is an incident; 条件 a condition.

任.name: Duty
任.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a <radical>samurai</radical>'s load <radical>slide</radical>ing off. It's their <kanji>duty</kanji> to carry it.
任.reading: They're a ninja, にん. 責任 is responsibility; 任せる to entrust.

増.name: Increase
増.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical> piled on what was there <radical>formerly</radical>. The heap keeps <kanji>increase</kanji>ing.
増.reading: An elephant, ぞう, adds more. 増える is to increase.

情.name: Emotion
情.reading: A joker, じょう, cheers you up. 感情 is emotion; 情報 information. Note 青, a sound hint (せい, じょう).

示.name: Show
示.meaning: The <radical>show</radical> radical, an altar with offerings. As a kanji it means <kanji>show</kanji>.
示.reading: Show it off in a jeep, じ. 指示 is instructions; 示す to show.

確.name: Certain
確.meaning: A <radical>stone</radical> next to a <radical>turkey</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. Weigh the turkey with a stone to be <kanji>certain</kanji>.
確.reading: A cackling witch, かく, checks the scales. 確か is certain; 確認 confirmation.

容.name: Contain
容.meaning: A <radical>valley</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. The house is big enough to <kanji>contain</kanji> a whole valley.
容.reading: Do yo-yo tricks, よう, inside. 内容 is content; 美容院 a beauty salon.

演.name: Perform
演.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>roof</radical>, a <radical>reason</radical> and <radical>eight</radical>. Eight actors under one roof with a reason to <kanji>perform</kanji>.
演.reading: Tickets are one yen, えん. 演技 is acting; 講演 a lecture.

能.name: Ability
能.meaning: Something <radical>private</radical>, the <radical>moon</radical> and two <radical>spoon</radical>s. Bending spoons in the moonlight: a secret <kanji>ability</kanji>.
能.reading: Write it in your notebook, のう. 能力 is ability; 可能 possible.

格.name: Status
格.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> for <radical>each</radical> person. The taller your tree, the higher your <kanji>status</kanji>.
格.reading: A cackling witch, かく, measures them. 性格 is personality; 合格 passing an exam.

過.name: Pass
過.meaning: A <radical>helmet</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. It zooms <kanji>pass</kanji>t everything.
過.reading: Faster than a car, か. 過去 is the past; 過ぎる to pass.

常.name: Usual
常.meaning: <radical>Esteem</radical> over a <radical>towel</radical>. Hanging the towel neatly is the <kanji>usual</kanji> thing.
常.reading: A joker, じょう, messes it up. 日常 is daily life; 非常 emergency.

状.name: Condition
状.meaning: A <radical>dog</radical> next to a <radical>bed</radical>. Check its <kanji>condition</kanji>: it's sick.
状.reading: A joker, じょう, is the vet. 状態 is condition; 年賀状 a New Year card.

職.name: Job
職.meaning: An <radical>ear</radical>, a <radical>sound</radical> and a <radical>halberd</radical>. You listen for trouble and hold your halberd: it's your <kanji>job</kanji>.
職.reading: The job gives you a shock, しょく. 職業 is occupation; 就職 getting a job.

構.name: Structure
構.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and <radical>again</radical>. Stack wood three times again and you have a <kanji>structure</kanji>.
構.reading: A koala, こう, moves in. 結構 is fine; 構う to mind.

断.name: Refuse
断.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical> and an <radical>axe</radical>. Chop the rice offering in half: you <kanji>refuse</kanji> it.
断.reading: The dancer, だん, is offended. 断る is to refuse; 判断 judgement.

規.name: Standard
規.meaning: A <radical>husband</radical> who can <radical>see</radical> everything. He sets the <kanji>standard</kanji>.
規.reading: He keeps it locked with a key, き. 規則 is a rule.

術.name: Technique
術.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> with a <radical>drop</radical> in the middle of <radical>go</radical>. Growing a tree in the road takes <kanji>technique</kanji>.
術.reading: A jujitsu master, じゅつ, shows you. 技術 is technology; 美術 fine art.

備.name: Prepare
備.meaning: A <radical>person</radical>, <radical>grass</radical> and a <radical>cliff</radical> ready to <radical>use</radical>. They <kanji>prepare</kanji> for the climb.
備.reading: They pack a bee hive, び. 準備 is preparation.

限.name: Limit
限.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> with a <radical>root</radical> that won't budge. That's the <kanji>limit</kanji>.
限.reading: A genie, げん, grants you no more than three wishes. 限る is to limit; 期限 a deadline.

退.name: Retreat
退.meaning: A <radical>root</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Even the roots <kanji>retreat</kanji>.
退.reading: Straighten your tie, たい, and walk away. 退院 is leaving hospital; 退屈 boredom.

財.name: Wealth
財.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical> and <radical>talent</radical>. Talent turns into money: <kanji>wealth</kanji>.
財.reading: Play it on a gold xylophone, ざい. 財布 is a wallet (さい).

識.name: Knowledge
識.meaning: <radical>Say</radical>, <radical>sound</radical> and a <radical>halberd</radical>. Words and sounds are the weapons of <kanji>knowledge</kanji>.
識.reading: A sheik, しき, has a lot of it. 知識 is knowledge; 常識 common sense.

程.name: Extent
程.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> that you <radical>present</radical>. How much? It depends on the <kanji>extent</kanji> of the harvest.
程.reading: Lay it on a table, てい. 程度 is degree; ほど extent.

師.name: Teacher
師.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> and a <radical>towel</radical>, with something <radical>slide</radical>ing. The <kanji>teacher</kanji> points with a stick and wipes the board.
師.reading: The teacher is a sheep, し. 教師 is a teacher; 医師 a doctor.

易.name: Easy
易.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over a <radical>banner</radical>. Sunny weather and a flag to follow: it's <kanji>easy</kanji>.
易.reading: So easy an eel, い, could do it. 易しい is easy; 貿易 trade (えき).

破.name: Tear
破.meaning: A <radical>stone</radical> and <radical>skin</radical>. Scrape your skin on a stone and it will <kanji>tear</kanji>.
破.reading: "Ha!" は, laughs the stone. 破る is to tear; 破壊 destruction.

因.name: Cause
因.meaning: Something <radical>big</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>. That's the <kanji>cause</kanji> of the fence breaking.
因.reading: It escaped from an inn, いん. 原因 is cause.

富.name: Wealth
富.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> and a full <radical>rice paddy</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. Food in the house: that's <kanji>wealth</kanji>.
富.reading: Hoard it behind a hoof, ふ. 富士山 is Mt Fuji; 豊富 abundant.

適.name: Suitable
適.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical> and something <radical>old</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Pick the most <kanji>suitable</kanji> hat for the ride.
適.reading: It's a tech gadget, てき, of a hat. 適当 is appropriate or careless.

婦.name: Wife
婦.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> with a <radical>broom</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and a <radical>towel</radical>. The old picture of a <kanji>wife</kanji>. (Luckily times change.)
婦.reading: She steps on a hoof, ふ. 夫婦 is husband and wife; 主婦 a housewife.

寄.name: Drop By
寄.meaning: Something <radical>strange</radical> under your <radical>roof</radical>. A stranger has <kanji>drop</kanji>ped <kanji>by</kanji>.
寄.reading: They borrowed a key, き. 寄る is to drop by; 寄付 a donation.

余.name: Surplus
余.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with a roof over something <radical>small</radical>. After everyone ate there's a small <kanji>surplus</kanji>.
余.reading: Feed it to a yo-yo, よ. 余る is to be left over; 余裕 room to spare.

妻.name: Wife
妻.meaning: A <radical>broom</radical> with a hairpin, above a <radical>woman</radical>. It's your <kanji>wife</kanji>.
妻.reading: She has a scythe, さい. 妻 on its own is つま; 夫妻 Mr and Mrs.

険.name: Steep
険.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> next to a <radical>person</radical> on the <radical>ground</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical> open. They're shouting because it's <kanji>steep</kanji> and dangerous.
険.reading: Ken, けん, slips. 危険 is danger; 冒険 adventure.

許.name: Permit
許.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> it at <radical>noon</radical>. The lord only gives <kanji>permit</kanji>s at noon.
許.reading: It's in Kyoto, きょ. 許す is to allow; 免許 a licence.

留.name: Stay
留.meaning: A <radical>stamp</radical> over a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. The field is stamped as yours so you <kanji>stay</kanji>.
留.reading: A dragon, りゅう, guards it. 留学 is studying abroad; 留守 away from home (る).

罪.name: Crime
罪.meaning: A <radical>net</radical> over something <radical>wrong</radical>. Catch the <kanji>crime</kanji> in a net.
罪.reading: Stolen: a xylophone, ざい. 犯罪 is crime; 罪 sin (つみ).

精.name: Spirit
精.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical> polished until it's <radical>blue</radical>. Refined down to its <kanji>spirit</kanji>.
精.reading: Offer it to a sailor, せい. 精神 is spirit, mind.

絶.name: Sever
絶.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> of every <radical>color</radical>. Cut them all: <kanji>sever</kanji> the ties.
絶.reading: Ride off on a zebra, ぜつ. 絶対 is absolutely.

居.name: Reside
居.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> over something <radical>old</radical>. Where the old flag hangs is where you <kanji>reside</kanji>.
居.reading: In Kyoto, きょ. 居る is to be (いる); 住居 dwelling.

雑.name: Miscellaneous
雑.meaning: <radical>Nine</radical>, a <radical>tree</radical> and a <radical>turkey</radical>. A <kanji>miscellaneous</kanji> pile of random stuff.
雑.reading: It gets zapped, ざつ. 雑誌 is a magazine; 複雑 complicated.

招.name: Invite
招.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> beckoning to <radical>summon</radical> someone. You <kanji>invite</kanji> them over.
招.reading: To a show, しょう. 招待 is an invitation.

賛.name: Approve
賛.meaning: Two <radical>husband</radical>s over a <radical>shell</radical>. Both husbands put money in: they <kanji>approve</kanji>.
賛.reading: Under the sun, さん. 賛成 is agreement.

犯.name: Crime
犯.meaning: An <radical>animal</radical> in a <radical>crouch</radical>. It's about to commit a <kanji>crime</kanji>.
犯.reading: Caught with its hand, はん, in the jar. 犯人 is a criminal; 犯罪 crime.

似.name: Resemble
似.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to <radical>by means of</radical>. By means of a mask they <kanji>resemble</kanji> you.
似.reading: They drive your jeep, じ, too. 似る is to resemble; 似合う to suit.

迷.name: Lost
迷.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. The rice delivery got <kanji>lost</kanji>.
迷.reading: A maid, めい, is looking for it. 迷う is to get lost; 迷惑 a nuisance.

夢.name: Dream
夢.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, a <radical>net</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and <radical>evening</radical>. Lie in the grass under a net at night and you <kanji>dream</kanji>.
夢.reading: Of a mooing cow, む. 夢 on its own is ゆめ; 夢中 absorbed.

慣.name: Accustomed
慣.meaning: <radical>Feelings</radical> that have been <radical>pierce</radical>d so often you're <kanji>accustomed</kanji> to it.
慣.reading: A kangaroo, かん, kicks you every day. 習慣 is a habit; 慣れる to get used to.

貧.name: Poor
貧.meaning: A <radical>part</radical> of a <radical>shell</radical>. Only part of a coin left: you're <kanji>poor</kanji>.
貧.reading: It's stuck in a hinge, ひん. 貧しい is poor; 貧乏 poverty (びん).

祖.name: Ancestor
祖.meaning: An <radical>altar</radical> with <radical>moreover</radical> stacked on it: generation upon generation. It's for your <kanji>ancestor</kanji>s.
祖.reading: Stitched with a sewing needle, そ. 祖父 is grandfather; 祖母 grandmother.
